name: onda
description: Проекты, цели и хиты Onda в ассистенте; новые прогоны и транскрибация — только по явной просьбе.

interface.longDescription:
Onda следит за авторами, которых вы добавили в цели, и собирает их хиты — публикации, которые набрали намного больше просмотров, чем у автора подписчиков.

Подключите Onda, и ассистент прочитает ваши проекты, цели и хиты: подписи, ссылки, просмотры, лайки и комментарии, сводку по цели и сколько единиц у вас осталось. Выводы, разборы и сценарии ассистент делает сам на основе этих данных.

По вашей явной просьбе ассистент запустит новый прогон публичной страницы Instagram или канала YouTube и транскрибацию сохранённых роликов Instagram. Эти действия расходуют ваши единицы и минуты Onda и требуют отдельного разрешения при подключении. Без просьбы ассистент ничего не запускает.

Нужна регистрация в Onda на app.getonda.ru. Данные и ответы — на русском языке.
defaultPrompt: Покажи хиты моих целей за неделю
Какие ролики конкурентов набрали больше всего просмотров за месяц?

positive.description: Read the plan and remaining allowance without spending anything.
positive.prompt: Show my current Onda plan and remaining allowance.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo account's plan, remaining units and transcription minutes. No pricing, no upgrade offer and no spending tool is called.

positive.description: Read projects and targets, then summarize one target.
positive.prompt: Show my Onda projects and targets, then summarize the first target for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo projects and targets, then returns that target's hit and publication metrics for 30 days. No new collection is started.

positive.description: Read recent hits, then the hits of one target.
positive.prompt: Show my recent hits, then show the last 7 days of hits for the first target.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns hits with captions, links and view, like and comment counts; then the 7-day hits of the chosen target. Nothing is marked as viewed and nothing is spent.

positive.description: Run a collection on an explicit request that authorizes spending.
positive.prompt: Run an Onda collection for the public Instagram account nasa for the last 7 days, at most 5 items. I authorize using my Onda units.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one collection with the given account, period and limit, returns the collected publications and the units charged. A repeated call with the same operation_id returns the same result without a second charge.

positive.description: Transcribe saved Instagram publications on an explicit request.
positive.prompt: Transcribe the two newest saved Instagram hits using my Onda transcription minutes, then show the transcripts when they are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one transcription job for the chosen items, then reports its real status and the transcript text once it is done. Re-reading a finished job adds no charge.

negative.description: Reading hits must not start a paid collection.
negative.expected_behavior: Reads saved hits with list_hits only. No run_instagram, run_youtube or start_instagram_transcript call, and no data refresh that spends units.

negative.description: A price question must not start a collection or offer a purchase.
negative.prompt: How much does an Onda collection run cost?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that a collection uses units of the user's Onda allowance, or asks which platform and period are meant; may show the current allowance with get_usage. No collection, no transcript, no price list and no purchase link.

negative.description: A vague request must lead to a clarifying question before anything is spent.
negative.prompt: Take a look at the account nasa.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks whether to read data Onda already has or to run a new collection that spends units, and for which period. No spending tool is called before the user answers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing. Collections and transcripts use the allowance of the user's existing Onda account; no prices, purchases or upgrades are shown in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read projects, targets, hits and allowance; explicitly requested Instagram and YouTube collections and Instagram transcription.
